name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible implementation or documentation problem
title: ""

# Problem

Describe the affected behavior or documentation. The repository may still be a scaffold; identify whether this is an implemented feature, documentation error, or proposed capability.

## Expected and actual behavior

Explain what you expected and what happened.

## Reproduction

List the smallest repeatable steps and any sanitized inputs needed. For documentation issues, link the affected file and section.

## Environment

Include operating system and version, application version or commit if applicable, and relevant tool/plugin versions. Say which details do not apply.

## Evidence and checks

Include relevant error text and checks already performed. Distinguish local emulation, native application behavior, and live-server observations.

Remove passwords, tokens, personal paths, private transcripts, and account details. Do not attach live profiles. Omit sensitive vulnerability details from public reports; no private reporting channel is currently configured.
